notes.title: First Playtest Soon to be Live!
notes.content:
[p]Hey!

The first playtesting session of Edelweiss Knights is happening soon.[/p][p]You can visit the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3200470/Edelweiss_Knights/"]Store Page[/url] and request access to our Playtest.

Please follow our News to stay informed about the start date of our Playtest.

[b]About the Game

[/b]We're building Edelweiss Knights out of our love for classic JRPGs, turn-based mechanics, and character-driven storytelling. Oh, and fine pastry... but that's a story for another day.

If you have fond memories of that long-gone time in gaming, there's a good chance you'll find something of your liking in our bite-sized take on the genre![/p][p]
Meanwhile, why don't you join our [url="https://discord.gg/nBm9uXsWdT"]Discord[/url] community?[/p]
